name: Why hire a general contractor for interior repairs instead of individual handymen?

mainEntity.name: Why hire a general contractor for interior repairs instead of individual handymen?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general contractor manages the entire scope when repairs span multiple building trades. While a specialized painter or drywaller handles surface patches, an interior contractor addresses structural wood framing, drywall hung to correct framing defects, finish trim carpentry, and tile installation. If electrical lines or water pipes behind the wall caused the damage, an owner-operated general contractor oversees trade coordination, ensuring plumbing and electrical work are handled safely while their team repairs the framing, drywall, and paint.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general contractor coordinates structural framing, drywall, tile, and required mechanical trades under a single lead point of contact.
